venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.weather: Highs in the mid 90s with scattered storms around open, lows in the 70s
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Thursday 7/9 (MOD JK):** Slow to start due to a passing thunderstorm at open. Guest flow picked up around 6pm and again at 7:30pm, then held steady for several hours — lined bar, full booths, and most of the Mezz sat for a while. Two guests returned two orders of wings ("thought it would be crispier"), both comped to DNL and replaced with Jojo's, which they loved. Barback started the Acid Celery Cordial (clarifying done; acids to be added tomorrow before refilling the liner). Opener cut just before 7:30pm; MOD supported closer 8–10pm. Kitchen: good communication with FOH on food sitting in windows. Maintenance: work order sent to manufacturer on the torn gasket in the cooler behind Well 100 (still under warranty). Low: c-folds and toilet paper (ordered). Comps $104.65. Favorite moment: guest reactions to the disco ball. Net $2,302 vs. $2,146 target; 53 guests, $43.44 check avg.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Thursday 7/9 (MOD KK/MD, Chef JMS):** Busy Thursday night. The Riversteps Concert Series brought a lot of people out despite hot, humid weather — an earlier pop around 7pm with an additional pop toward the end of the show, and steady business until about 11pm. Really solid night. Kitchen: John-Michael was a tremendous help taking trips to the floor while holding down the kitchen. Maintenance: Well 3 froster; new — Well 2 sink pedals sticking (water doesn't shut off right away). 86: cider (returns tomorrow). Favorite moment: jumping into a busy service with Maury and Sara while Brandon C held it down outside; the Charmers/Cauponer crew came over after their service to celebrate bartender Zach's birthday. Comps $75.45 (1.3%). Net $5,699 vs. $3,450 target; ~212 guests, $26.88 check avg.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.weather: Lightly overcast with brief misting; mostly beautiful and pleasant
venues.narrative: **DVR — Thursday 7/9 (AM Maggie S / Chef Josh; PM Chef Lucas / Evan):** Fun, easy-going Thursday. Cafe/AM $642.29 — Reggie floated between the event and cafe; coffee and matcha order squared away. D&C PM $7,657.75 — pretty chill night, never went on a wait, lots of friendly faces and good connections. Garden/6A $2,798.57 — easy peezy, Dominique and Jordan holding it down. Kitchen: chill night with Nate and Marv (good to have him back). Events: Day 3 of High School Success, 25 guests 8am–2pm in Vauxhall; Josh knocked out a breakfast buffet and to-go lunch (taken to Cheeseman Park). Claire and company thanked the team for another successful year ($2,854 event food / $3,179 net event). Comps $312.76 (~3.77%). Maintenance: request to dim/adjust the under-bar lights nearest the entrance behind Marquee. Net $8,300.04 (excl. events) vs. $11,045 target; 146 guests; $11,479.04 including events.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Thursday 7/9 (MOD Kyler / Chef Steves):** A steady night with multiple rounds, date-night heavy in the earlier turns; end of night saw guests interested in spirits and Death & Co history. Thomas and the team kept a good flow of drinks while turning tables and keeping wait times low. Top sellers: Native Lion, Burner Phone, Dramatic Exit. Door: despite a forecast for a slower evening, a line formed by 8pm — lots of 3s and 4s (no large parties) built a steady medium wait, the room full until 12:30am. Many first-timers and tourists (a group from Utah celebrating their daughter's published book), one bachelor party, plus regulars Koba, Jacqueline, Megan, Henry, Sarju and Zoe Becker from Eater NY. Retail $40. Glassware: 1 footed pilsner. Maintenance: AC over T4 won't stop dripping. Comps $341.62 (5.9%, lots of industry and gifts). Net $5,834 vs. $5,634 target; 155 guests, $38 check avg.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Thursday 7/9 (MOD Gigi / Chef Oscar/Saleh):** (Report date field typed 7/10 but this is the Thursday 7/9 service.) A steady Thursday from the start, with two servers from the get-go seating almost the whole room by 7:30pm. Several larger groups and a ton of 2-tops made the room feel busy and alive — definitely date night. Xavier crushed his last training shift; Jaz oversaw/trained, handled the floor, and sold ice cream/sorbet. Chef Selenia helped break Landis upstairs; smooth sailing after. Hit a big lull at 10pm that never quite picked back up — streets were quiet all around, a slower week overall as everyone recovers from the holiday/FIFA weekend (ChaChaCha/Cineopera also had their grand opening). Kitchen: great night for food, lots of crudo and steak tartare. Maintenance: kitchen lowboy gaskets replaced; gas company coming tomorrow; SR grates screwed in. Comps $193. Favorite moment: surprising a walk-in birthday guest with a card waiting at the bar. Net $5,472 vs. $6,701 target; 165 guests, $92.40 check avg.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Thursday 7/9 (MOD Marcus):** Stormy weather kept foot traffic light to start, with small pops around 6:30pm and 8:00pm before settling into a steady evening. Plumbers on site since 8am got one water heater back online just as service began. Kitchen was closed due to unforeseen circumstances, so the team ran the snack menu — Devan did a great job communicating with reservation guests in advance and on arrival. Dropped to one server around 9:30pm; Tyler finished sidework and left by 10pm while Mariah held the floor with Devan's support. Bar top ebbed and flowed; natural last call at 11:30pm though tables didn't clear until after 1am. Guests: 95 total (33 reso, 62 walk-in). Maintenance: service entrance flooring, curtains coming off rails, second bathroom toilet seat loose. Comps $59.12 (gift $20, community/investor $39.12). Favorite moment: making dip and having the team taste-test. Net $3,763.20 vs. $5,197 target; 95 guests, $36.52 check avg.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Sunny and hot; a big 30-minute rainstorm around 8pm
venues.narrative: **MG — Thursday 7/9 (AM Sam; PM Justin & Shannon/Drew):** One-year anniversary night! Municipal Bar AM $1,136 (28 covers) — early start with hotel guests, peak at 10am with Sierra solo, Catie in at 12 and training Brittany on day two. Municipal Bar PM $4,207 (101 covers) — quiet happy hour, bar filled decently early, floor popping around 7pm; a big storm sent guests in to hide, then a smaller rush after it lifted, with a 9:30pm push from the Lucas movie release. Ran by three servers with full support. Regulars Kala and Zach (our first guests ever) came through. Sun Club $222 — steady, all guests gone by 5:30. Hot Eye $494 — painfully slow (likely Palm Wine competition); a 9pm bachelorette, then an early last call. Kitchen: moving and grooving, one smelly roasted oyster, no other sendbacks. Maintenance: first-well bar drain tube removed and soaking (heavy blockage — needs replacing/fastening in the morning); water damage to paint in THE. Comps $117. Net $6,082 vs. $6,000 target; 129 guests, $47.15 check avg.
